policy.statement: Resource identities use bundled Tabler SVG components or locally rendered text monograms. No remote images, official seals, external fonts, or third-party logo files are shipped.

identityBases.usageBasis: Existing project dependency used for generic type glyphs and the GitHub, Reddit, Slack, and Microsoft brand glyphs.
Plain-text abbreviations identify owners when shipping an official or vendor mark is unnecessary or its redistribution terms are not established.
